name: MMMU
intro: MMMU是一个评估多模态模型在需要大学水平知识和推理任务上的基准，包含来自六个学科的11,550个问题和多样化图像类型。该基准设计用于测试模型的高级感知与领域知识推理能力。
org: IN.AI Research, University of Waterloo, The Ohio State University, Independent, Carnegie Mellon University, University of Victoria, Princeton University
modality: 文本, 图像, 多模态
task_type: 选择题, 开放式问答
eval_feature: 大学级知识, 多模态推理, 领域专家能力
eval_feature_en: College-level knowledge, multimodal reasoning, expert capability
intro_en: MMMU is a benchmark for evaluating multimodal models on tasks requiring university-level knowledge and reasoning. It includes 11,550 questions from six disciplines and diverse image types. The benchmark is designed to test models' advanced perception and domain knowledge reasoning abilities.

drawio_review_note: Paper/source audit completed 2026-07-21 against arXiv:2311.16502v4, Sections 3.1-4 and Appendix H; v4 PDF SHA-256 cb474e70a6728110aa39d94480535f482a656c5a65bfc2129b47d66350f1f974. The paper-era official repository is pinned at f3e473e1e7af2c65a56ab66d7b3cf09c5dbaf0b9 (2024-05-31); eval/utils/eval_utils.py SHA-256 is cc1a89b4a27f697702d340bc6a7578b5237135754ddaa9ef105239a3d9847367. The matching Hugging Face snapshot is ff942ca882854a926b6a0e6ee110fd46de71c9a0 (2024-05-31). Both code and data declare Apache-2.0; source questions remain subject to the rights of the original websites, textbooks, quizzes, and lecture materials. Construction selects six disciplines, 30 subjects, and more than 183 subfields where visual inputs provide value; over 50 specialist university students collect or author about 13K English college-level questions while avoiding prohibited redistribution and immediately available answers. Samples require one or more images and are multiple-choice with one correct option or short open answers. Lexical overlap and source-URL similarity nominate duplicates for author adjudication; coauthors standardize format, correct typos, review ambiguities, assign four difficulty levels, and remove roughly 10% very-easy items. The final 11,550 questions comprise 10,861 multiple-choice and 689 open items across 30 image types, split into 150 development, 900 validation, and 10,500 test rows. The pinned release schema is id, question, options, explanation, image_1 through image_7, img_type, answer, topic_difficulty, question_type, and subfield. Evaluation is zero-shot with each model's default task prompt; when unavailable, prompts are selected on validation. The released LLaVA example uses temperature 0, MC instruction 'Answer with the option's letter from the given choices directly.', short-answer instruction 'Answer the question using a single word or phrase.', and seed 42. MC parsing searches bracketed labels, then standalone labels, then option text only for responses longer than five tokens; multiple hits resolve to the last occurrence, while no hit invokes seeded random.choice. Open parsing extracts conclusion clauses and numbers, lowercases strings, rounds numeric candidates to two decimals, and scores string containment or numeric equality; an unmatched open response receives zero without random repair. Each evaluated row scores 0/1 and subject results are weighted by num_example for micro accuracy. A denominator caveat is preserved: main_eval_only.py iterates only supplied prediction IDs, skips missing categories, and never inserts omitted benchmark rows, so an incomplete prediction file can shrink the denominator; unknown IDs or malformed inputs can abort instead of receiving a defined zero. Later mutable repository/data updates, including 2026 answer corrections, are not silently merged into the paper-v4 snapshot. The bilingual specs have identical 23-node, 25-edge topology, academic-paper/academic-color/orthogonal styling, default 11-point theme typography, and four decision nodes whose outgoing edges reach distinct real outcomes with bilingual labels. After a density-focused horizontal compaction that preserves 32-pixel terminal connector segments, temporary Desktop rendering was reviewed at 1,829 x 1,305 pixels and again at 90% (1,646 x 1,174) in both languages; no clipping, overlap, duplicate edge labels, or connector-node crossings were found. Formal publication evidence [site-a11o-paper-alignment]: normalized Draw.io and architecture sidecars plus native fixed-light SVG/PNG pairs were regenerated from the checked-in bilingual specs. Final PNG dimensions are 1829×1305 (English) and 1829×1305 (Chinese); SVG viewBoxes are 1827×1303 and 1827×1303. The final exports were inspected without clipping, node overlap, connector-node crossing, fallback text, or adaptive colors.
